quests.title: Hard to Track

dialogue.section: Go to Liyue Harbor's wharf

dialogue.t: Excuse me, have you perchance seen any "evil spirits"?

dialogue.sit: "Evil spirits"?

dialogue.t: Oh, my apologies. You're not from around here, are you? This question must sound a little confusing to you.
I'm Chongyun, a local exorcist from Liyue. Those versed in the arts of exorcism refer to all forms of demons and monsters as "evil spirits."
Evil spirits have existed since ancient times. They lurk among the shadows in the lands of Liyue, stirring up all sorts of trouble and mischief.
It is my duty to exorcise or destroy them and protect the citizens here from their evil doings.

dialogue.sit: That is an admirable job.

dialogue.t: It's work that must be done, much like any other job. That's all.

dialogue.sit: That sounds similar to the work of adventurers.

dialogue.t: Really... Please, enlighten me.

dialogue.sit: I have also been traveling across Liyue, rescuing people from monsters, and collecting treasures along the way.

dialogue.t: Oh, I see! There are some similarities.

dialogue.sit: I get it, that's what the Vigilant Yaksha fights against, right?

dialogue.t: How did you come to know of the Vigilant Yaksha?
I have great respect for the yakshas. For generations, yakshas and exorcists have been protecting Liyue together, one in plain sight and the other in secret.
Sorry, I digress.
Judging from your response, it seems you aren't well-versed in the realm of evil spirits... But that's understandable. If I may ask, have you happened to come across anything strange recently?
Sometimes even the most trivial matters prove helpful in my hunt for evil spirits.

dialogue.sit: Hmm, nothing in particular.

dialogue.t: Oh, I see. Well, fair enough...
In that case, I guess I'll just have to try my luck with the clues I already have.

dialogue.sit: What clues do you have now?

dialogue.t: *sigh* Only some scattered reports, really. Nothing too significant yet...
But if you're interested, I can tell you about some of the more useful ones I've gathered so far.
I read a flyer that said: "The Test of Courage is now being held on Wuwang Hill. Bring your best friend and test your courage together!"
Then: "Recently, the sounds of footsteps and shouting have been heard outside people's windows at night. The noises have frightened the children and they are unable to sleep."
And: "A huge shadow has appeared in Guili Plains. It flies and swirls, summons down fireballs, and makes all sorts of strange noises."
Cases such as these might actually be worth our attention.

dialogue.sit: Test of Courage... Doesn't that sound like an advertisement?

dialogue.t: I think something strange must have happened at the Test of Courage...
I guess this so-called "test" is supposed to be like a "test of mettle." Its purpose must be to try the will and power of exorcists.

dialogue.sit: Sometimes drunkards pass by people's windows at night, that's nothing unusual.

dialogue.t: Hmm, unless there was a problem with the drinks, I don't think drunkards would scare the children that much.

dialogue.sit: The shadow in Guili Plains sounds like it may be a Ruin Hunter.

dialogue.t: Ruin Hunter? Hmm, that would fit the description, but why has no one recognized it?
Do you think I'm not deciphering these clues correctly?

dialogue.sit: (They all sound pretty farfetched, perhaps I should just tell him that.)

dialogue.t: So you don't think any of these clues are related to evil spirits?
Sorry... Please give me a moment to calm myself.

dialogue.sit: I'm sorry, I didn't realize it would be so devastating to you.

dialogue.t: ...No, it's fine. I've been this way since I was young.

dialogue.sit: Oh, is it... health-related?

dialogue.t: No, not at all. I guess you could say that I just tend to be... unstable... you know, emotionally. It causes me to become very uncomfortable at times.
This tendency of getting stirred up easily is what people call a "pure-yang spirit."

dialogue.sit: "Stirred up easily"? I couldn't tell that from your appearance...

dialogue.t: Yes, well, such a constitution is very rare, but it's a potent weapon for an exorcist. My constitution alone is capable of scaring off evil spirits.
But I must constantly focus on my emotions... Otherwise, I may easily do something out of control.
...Anyway... I carefully selected these clues from an ocean of information. I can't believe they're all completely irrelevant.
Oh no... I'm still feeling quite uncomfortable. There's heat growing in my chest... I—I can't breathe.

dialogue.sit: Shall I take you to Bubu Pharmacy?
How about some water?
Shall I try rubbing your Vision on your forehead?

dialogue.t: No, I'll be alright. I—I brought some popsicles with me for just such situations.
...I—I feel much better now.

dialogue.sit: That's an unexpected solution.

dialogue.t: ...It's quite effective. I'm always sure to bring some popsicles with me whenever I go out.

dialogue.sit: It looked tasty.

dialogue.t: Actually, they're quite tasteless. Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to stomach them.
*sigh* Thank you for your concern. I'm fine now.
But what should I do next if all these clues are irrelevant?

dialogue.sit: Actually, it seems someone's been watching us this whole time...

dialogue.t: Yes, I've noticed him too.
It's no coincidence that we both noticed it. I'm sure he's watching us.
But it doesn't seem he has any intentions other than looking at us... Perhaps there's something he wishes to tell us?

dialogue.sit: Let's go and ask him.

dialogue.t: Right, he might need our help.

dialogue.sit: Maybe he's just shy.

dialogue.t: Hmm, possible... Let's go and ask him.
Hmm... I think the clue about the Test of Courage is the most relevant one I have so far.
If strange things have been happening at the event, then evil spirits may well be the cause.
*sigh* But there's an unusual requirement for this event. You must be a team of two people in order to participate.

dialogue.sit: Actually, that's quite normal.

dialogue.t: Is it? Huh... perhaps you're right. If evil spirits do show up, then the two can take care of each other, I suppose.

dialogue.sit: The aim is to strengthen the relationship between the two participants.

dialogue.t: Uh...? Strengthen the relationship...? Sorry, I don't really get it.
Anyway, if you have the time, would you join me for this event?
You seem to have a good eye for discerning these clues. With your adventuring experience, I'm sure we'll track down those evil spirits in no time.

dialogue.sit: Okay, I'm free now anyway.

dialogue.t: Thank you! I was starting to worry that I wouldn't be able to find a partner.

dialogue.sit: Sorry, I'm not interested...

dialogue.t: Please, you must go with me! I don't know if I'll be able to find anyone else suitable to join me.
My best friend is busy with other matters, and I worry that anyone else won't even be able to protect themselves.

dialogue.sit: Fine, if you say so.

dialogue.t: Ah, you have my thanks!
We should make haste! If there are evil spirits at the event, then things could get dangerous.

quests.description: As you approach the wharf of Liyue Harbor, an unusually-dressed young man comes up to you, asking after some really strange business...

quests.title: Distant Gaze

dialogue.section: Talk to the child who was looking your way

dialogue.t: O—Oh, huh?
Sorry, I'll leave now.
No, please relax, there's no need to worry. We're not here for trouble. We couldn't help but notice you standing here for a while and thought that you might have something on your mind.
No, there's nothing on my mind, I just thought... the thing you were eating looked tasty.
My sister just loves food. She's always super happy whenever we get some tasty snacks.
I'm her big brother and I should take care of her, but... Mom says we are too poor and she never lets me buy any snacks.
Oh, you mean one of my popsicles? I'm afraid you wouldn't find them very tasty, though.
It doesn't matter. My sister's never had anything like that before. I know she'd be happy to try one. Hmm, come to think of it, I've never had one either...
I see. Hmm... That might be difficult.

dialogue.sit: What's wrong?

dialogue.t: Well, I only have two popsicles left.
These popsicles are very important to me, and I might need them if we encounter an evil spirit. Without them, I might not be able to control my constitution.

dialogue.sit: What if you just give him one of the popsicles?

dialogue.t: Just give him one? Hmm, I suppose keeping the other for myself will be enough.
You see, my young friend, these popsicles are very important to me. I'm afraid I can only give you one.
That's okay, I don't need one, just as long as my sister is happy! Thanks a lot!
Whoa, it's already starting to melt. E—Excuse me, I'd better hurry back to Chihu Rock now!
I never expected that something I use to suppress my yang energy would be so appealing to kids.
Anyway, back to our hunt for evil spirits.
Earlier, it seemed like you could easily discern which clues were most credible. You must truly be a knowledgeable and seasoned adventurer.

dialogue.sit: I was just using good ol' common sense...

dialogue.t: I still have numerous clues from my friend which I haven't sorted through yet. With my limited experience, it's hard to tell whether they're reliable leads.
If you'd be willing, could you please come and take a look with me?

dialogue.sit: Sure thing.

dialogue.t: Alright, let's go to Wanwen Bookhouse. Please, follow me.
Hmm, you're right. I'll just have to make do without my popsicles then.
Here, my young friend, you can have my last two popsicles. You and your sister can each have one.
Really!? Wow! Th—Thanks a lot!
Hehe, just wait till my sister tries this. I haven't seen her smile in a long time!
Whoa, it's already starting to melt. E—Excuse me, I'd better hurry back to Chihu Rock now!
I never expected that something I use to suppress my yang energy would be so appealing to kids.
*sigh* But I wonder how I'll manage without any popsicles...

dialogue.sit: Can't you buy some more?
Are they difficult to make?

dialogue.t: I usually get my popsicles from Wanmin Restaurant on special order. The ingredients are not complicated, but the restaurant is always bustling with business and Chef Mao is usually too busy to take my order.
Now that I've used all my supply, I'll have to trouble him to make more.

dialogue.sit: I'll go with you.

dialogue.t: Oh, no need! I'm sure I can manage it on my own.

dialogue.sit: I'm a little worried about you.

dialogue.t: Oh, perhaps you were concerned by my unwell appearance earlier.
I appreciate your concern, but please don't worry about me. I assure you, I'm not that fragile.

dialogue.sit: I'm concerned about your abundance of yang energy.

dialogue.t: It's nothing to worry about. Over the years, I've grown quite accustomed to the discipline required to rein in my condition.

dialogue.sit: I was the one who convinced you to give away all your popsicles in the first place.

dialogue.t: No, please don't feel at fault. I think you made the right choice.
But if you're offering to come along, then I won't refuse.
Alright, please follow me to Wanmin Restaurant.

quests.description: The young thaumaturge Chongyun has obtained a great amount of (rather unreliable-sounding) information concerning evil spirits. He seems a little dejected when you point this out. As he uses a popsicle to suppress his pure-yang spirit, you both feel someone's gaze on you from the side.

quests.title: The Exorcist's Path

dialogue.section: Go to Wanwen Bookhouse and identify the clues

dialogue.t: This is a note that I received from a friend. It has many clues about evil spirits on it.
If we check the books here at Wanwen Bookhouse according to the respective clues on the note, we'll be able to find the complete details of each clue.
Since you're here to help, I'll just read the clues to you, and you can help me judge if they're credible or not based on your experience.

dialogue.sit: Leave it to me.

dialogue.t: Alright, here are the first clues.
"At the foot of Mt. Qingce is a Violetgrass that has turned into a gigantic, man-eating monster."
Also, "There's a ghostly shadow skulking about Feiyun Slope at night. It's suspected to be a vengeful spirit."
And finally, "Lurking in Liyue Harbor is a massive demon that was transformed from a popsicle."
Huh? I've never encountered any such things before.
Anyway, could you pick the one that seems most plausible and likely to be the work of evil spirits?

dialogue.sit: "At the foot of Mt. Qingce is a Violetgrass that has turned into a gigantic, man-eating monster."
"Lurking in Liyue Harbor is a massive demon that was transformed from a popsicle."

dialogue.t: ...This one seems unlikely. If such a thing did exist, there would be many witnesses in Qingce Village, but nobody has yet to see it.
Hmm, how about these clues?
"Deep in the Sea of Clouds, a marauding demon has been raiding commercial fishing boats and building a luxurious palace."
Or, "In Jueyun Karst, there's a piece of thousand-year-old amber that has gained consciousness and now roams about causing trouble."
And lastly, "It's said that people often see a demon who loves eating chilis in Wanmin Restaurant."

dialogue.sit: "In Jueyun Karst, there's a piece of thousand-year-old amber that has gained consciousness and now roams about causing trouble."

dialogue.t: Hmm, this is possible, but it sounds too similar to previous rumors. Many people often pass through Feiyun Slope, so perhaps it's just some sort of misunderstanding.
Hmm, how about these clues?
"Deep in the Sea of Clouds, a marauding demon has been raiding commercial fishing boats and building a luxurious palace."
Or, "In Jueyun Karst, there's a piece of thousand-year-old amber that has gained consciousness and now roams about causing trouble."
And lastly, "It's said that people often see a demon who loves eating chilis in Wanmin Restaurant."

dialogue.sit: "In Jueyun Karst, there's a piece of thousand-year-old amber that has gained consciousness and now roams about causing trouble."

dialogue.t: Popsicles can't turn into demons! Besides, I always keep a close eye on my stock of popsicles.
Hmm, how about these clues?
"Deep in the Sea of Clouds, a marauding demon has been raiding commercial fishing boats and building a luxurious palace."
Or, "In Jueyun Karst, there's a piece of thousand-year-old amber that has gained consciousness and now roams about causing trouble."
And lastly, "It's said that people often see a demon who loves eating chilis in Wanmin Restaurant."

dialogue.sit: "In Jueyun Karst, there's a piece of thousand-year-old amber that has gained consciousness and now roams about causing trouble."

dialogue.t: This one does seem possible, but it also sounds like a tale from unverifiable sources. Plus, we don't have any means of investigating the deep sea, either.
Okay, here are a few more clues.
"A strange man wearing a mask and wielding a pole was once seen in the distance around Guili Plains. There's something eerie about his presence."
Or, "Someone saw an exorcist with blue hair who is actually a transformed demon." Wait, what?
And finally, "There is a vigilant demon adept at concealing itself in mist. Recently, people have found traces of it in Mingyun Village, Guili Plains, and Yaoguang Shoal."

dialogue.sit: "A strange man wearing a mask and wielding a pole was once seen in the distance around Guili Plains. There's something eerie about his presence."
"There is a vigilant demon adept at concealing itself in mist. Recently, people have found traces of it in Mingyun Village, Guili Plains, and Yaoguang Shoal."

dialogue.t: Jueyun Karst is the territory of the Adepti. If there were such a thing, the Adepti would certainly take action...

dialogue.t: Even I can tell that this is talking about Xiangling's little Guoba, not some demon...
Okay, here are a few more clues.
"A strange man wearing a mask and wielding a pole was once seen in the distance around Guili Plains. There's something eerie about his presence."
Or, "Someone saw an exorcist with blue hair who is actually a transformed demon." Wait, what?
And finally, "There is a vigilant demon adept at concealing itself in mist. Recently, people have found traces of it in Mingyun Village, Guili Plains, and Yaoguang Shoal."

dialogue.sit: "A strange man wearing a mask and wielding a pole was once seen in the distance around Guili Plains. There's something eerie about his presence."
"There is a vigilant demon adept at concealing itself in mist. Recently, people have found traces of it in Mingyun Village, Guili Plains, and Yaoguang Shoal."

dialogue.t: Oh! That must be the Vigilant Yaksha. Don't worry, he's not an enemy.
It appears most of these clues are either not reliable or nearly impossible to investigate.
*sigh* It seems there is little here that we can actually use...

dialogue.sit: Out of curiosity, who gave you these clues?

dialogue.t: Oh, many of these are from my friend, Xingqiu. He's well-read and very knowledgeable.
Not to mention he's always willing to extend a helping hand. He always provides me with lots of reliable information.
If it weren't for my pure-yang spirit, I would have already vanquished numerous demons because of him, I'm sure of it.
I should find a chance to thank him personally.

dialogue.sit: Such... enviable friendship.

dialogue.t: Yes, he always goes out of his way for me, but he never seems to mind and helps me all the same. Also, he often has something interesting to say. I'm quite glad that I get along with him.

dialogue.sit: Maybe you should change your source of information.

dialogue.t: Do... do you mean that I shouldn't trouble him anymore?
Sorry, I digress. I've found another snippet of information here. There aren't many details, but it clearly mentions Wuwang Hill.
If we include the Test of Courage rumor from before, there are already two clues pointing there.
I've also noticed that the weather in Wuwang Hill has been very abnormal recently. Let's go and have a look. We might just find something useful.

dialogue.sit: I hope we can find something there.

dialogue.t: Alright, let's head out and see what we can find!
Hey! Not funny...

dialogue.section: Go to Wanwen Bookhouse and identify the clues

dialogue.t: I suspected that there would be hilichurls here.

dialogue.section: Go to the heretical ground mentioned in the clues

dialogue.t: This place seems quite... ordinary.
So ordinary that I don't even feel that it's worth investigating.

dialogue.sit: Same feeling here.

dialogue.t: Wuwang Hill's unusual weather and peculiar surroundings are a source of constant rumors, most of which are untraceable and can never be proven.
So, I suppose this could only be expected...

dialogue.sit: It seems you seldom have anything to show for all your efforts. Is that also due to your pure-yang spirit?

dialogue.t: I guess so. Like I mentioned before, my yang energy tends to just scare away evil spirits.
You may think it's beneficial for me to have such a condition, and therefore there's no real need for me to practice thaumaturgy.
But if I renounced my practice of thaumaturgy, and one day met an evil spirit that didn't fear my yang energy, then I may not be able to exorcise it.

dialogue.sit: No wonder you're so persistent.

dialogue.t: If I merely spend my time training without actually putting it into practice, then how would I ever know the fruits of my labor or what skills I need to improve?
But to this very day, despite the many exorcisms I have performed, I have yet to see a single demon, not to mention one that I needed to defeat using thaumaturgy.
*sigh* Sorry, I—I shouldn't rant like that. I'm fine, I've gotten used to such feelings...

dialogue.sit: Don't give up, Chongyun.

dialogue.t: Since we're already here, let's go check the two locations mentioned in the clue.

dialogue.section: Proceed deeper within to investigate

dialogue.t: What's this...?
I know this mist. It was left by some kind of evil spirit.
It's very thick and never disperses. The evil spirit may have been here recently.

dialogue.sit: So it seems the clue was real.
Great, our efforts have finally paid off!

dialogue.t: Yes, it was not all in vain.
But we mustn't act rashly. If this mist remains here, it can easily contaminate the area.
Once it contaminates monsters such as hilichurls, it could even make them more aggressive and dangerous to anyone nearby.
Or if it happens to contaminate any adventurers passing by, the consequences would be unimaginable.

dialogue.sit: I'll leave this to you.
It's your time to shine, Exorcist.

dialogue.t: My pleasure.
Let's inspect the surrounding area to see if there's any more mist like this. Once we've cleaned up this mess, we'll continue forward.
Remember, there might be danger ahead. We should be prepared for a fight.

dialogue.sit: You're very calm.
You're very thorough.

dialogue.t: It's second nature to me... Exorcism is a solemn and serious matter.
It's on me if you or anyone else gets hurt due to my negligence.
There's no time to lose. Let's go.

dialogue.section: Defeat the attacking hilichurls

dialogue.t: These tracks are still fresh. It seems the evil spirit is on the move.
The path ends here, as well as the tracks... It'll be difficult to follow it any further.

dialogue.sit: I didn't think your pure-yang spirit could be so powerful.

dialogue.t: It must have sensed me as a threat from a long way off. That's why it ran with such haste.
It seems that this is still not the kind of spirit that can overcome my abundant yang energy and fight me head-on.

dialogue.sit: But if we don't deal with it, it'll just go somewhere else and harm people, right?

dialogue.t: *sigh* Don't worry. I'll continue tracking it for a few days. It won't dare show its face around here again.

dialogue.sit: But you still won't ever see it, right?

dialogue.t: Most likely, yes. I'm afraid the best I can do is just scare it away.

dialogue.sit: It's a shame that we can't take care of it for good.

dialogue.t: Yes, defeating it once and for all would certainly make all this worth our efforts.
Hm? Why do you seem so disappointed?

dialogue.sit: I can't help but feel like this was a waste of our time.

dialogue.t: No, quite the contrary. Not only did we clean up the traces of the evil spirit, but we also took care of those monsters. We've done our jobs as exorcists.
My only regret is that I didn't get to drive it away using my thaumaturgy.
But I'm already prepared to spend my life chasing this goal, so I do not regret such disappointments.

dialogue.sit: Hmm, I guess you're right.

dialogue.t: Yes, so please cheer up.

dialogue.sit: Now you're comforting me?

dialogue.t: Of course. I'd never wish for you to be in low spirits on my account.
Actually, I also wanted to thank you for not leaving me, even with my special condition, and for helping chase the evil spirit to the very end.
Even if we'd ended up running into an incredibly strong demon, I would've felt much safer with an experienced adventurer like you by my side.

dialogue.sit: I'm just doing my duty.
Your persistence made it hard for me to leave...

dialogue.t: Well, I appreciate it. Oh, it seems the weather is starting to clear up over there. Let's go have a look.
Hmm, perhaps there's nothing to worry about after all. Even though I didn't come face to face with that evil spirit, at least I met you.

dialogue.sit: I'm not an evil spirit.

dialogue.t: Oh, no — that came out wrong. What I'm trying to say is...
We shouldn't focus only on the gains and losses of our journey. The things you see and the events you encounter along the way are equally important rewards.

quests.description: Dalong leaves after having been given half the popsicles, feeling quite pleased. After this small interlude, you and Chongyun continue discussing evil spirits. Chongyun hopes to tap on your abundant experience as an adventurer to adjudge the truth or falsehood of information concerning evil spirits. To that end, you head to Wanwen Bookhouse together.

quests.title: Popsicles and Their Curious Uses

dialogue.section: Talk to Chongyun and decide on your course of action

dialogue.t: ...This is bad. Chef Mao is not at the restaurant right now, and neither is Xiangling...
We'll have to wait till he returns... What do we do about the evil spirits?

dialogue.sit: If it's not too difficult, I can try to make some.

dialogue.t: Oh, are you a good cook?

dialogue.sit: Making popsicles seems easy enough.
I often cook for myself when adventuring in the wilderness.

dialogue.t: Then I'll leave it to you. Thanks for your help.

dialogue.sit: Do you know what ingredients we should use?

dialogue.t: Uhh... I'm afraid all I know is that it requires water. But to imbue the effect that suppresses my yang energy, perhaps something special is required.
Like different plants, fruits, or herbs, for example.
Do you have any experience with such things?

dialogue.sit: Let's try Mist Flower and Qingxin.
Let's try Sunsettia and Valberries.

dialogue.t: Oh, that sounds about right.
Coming up with the right ingredients off the top of your head like that... You most certainly are an experienced adventurer.
Hmm, those do sound refreshing, but the popsicles aren't sweet.
...But in case you know something I don't, I'll trust your judgment.
Uh, that sounds a little... dangerous.
But as the saying goes, "fight fire with fire." I trust your judgment.

dialogue.section: Talk to Chongyun and decide on your course of action

dialogue.t: Have you procured all the ingredients for the popsicles?

dialogue.section: Go to Wanmin Restaurant to help Chongyun restock on popsicles

dialogue.t: Have you procured all the ingredients for the popsicles?

dialogue.section: Bring the ingredients you prepared back to Chongyun

dialogue.t: Are they finished? Oh, they look exactly like the ones Chef Mao makes for me.
Let me try one.
*licks popsicle* Mmmm, yes...
...Good, this is the right feeling. I can sense the energy calming down within me.

dialogue.sit: These should help you keep control.

dialogue.t: Thank you, Traveler, now I have lots of popsicles. Your skills are amazing!
If I'd known you possess such skills, we could've made more for that kid and his family.

dialogue.sit: It'd have to be a lot more — I'm sure the kid would eat most of them and still be hungry.

dialogue.t: Haha, right. But he mentioned his family is not well-off. I'd still like to help them if I can.

dialogue.sit: But what about your search for evil spirits?

dialogue.t: Exorcism is my means of helping the people of Liyue live more peaceful and happy lives.
If that kid really needs my help, then helping him would just be different means to the same end.

dialogue.sit: I'll go with you.

dialogue.t: Alright. I remember the kid mentioned that he was headed for Chihu Rock. Let's go find him.

dialogue.section: Bring the ingredients you prepared back to Chongyun

dialogue.t: Have you procured all the ingredients for the popsicles?

dialogue.section: Bring the ingredients you prepared back to Chongyun

dialogue.t: Are they finished? Ahh... these look even tastier than my original popsicles!
Let me try one.
*licks popsicle* Mmmm, yes...
It tastes fruity and sweet... It's delicious!
But I'm afraid it's not as effective at suppressing my yang energy as Chef Mao's popsicles.

dialogue.sit: I thought just any popsicles would do.

dialogue.t: Sadly not, but in any case, these should be good enough for now.
These popsicles really are delicious... I bet that kid we met earlier would be thrilled to taste this flavor.

dialogue.sit: It'd have to be a lot more — I'm sure the kid would eat most of them and still be hungry.

dialogue.t: Haha, right. But he mentioned his family is not well-off. I'd still like to help them if I can.

dialogue.sit: But what about your search for evil spirits?

dialogue.t: Exorcism is my means of helping the people of Liyue live more peaceful and happy lives.
If that kid really needs my help, then helping him would just be different means to the same end.

dialogue.sit: I'll go with you.

dialogue.t: Alright. I remember the kid mentioned that he was headed for Chihu Rock. Let's go find him.

dialogue.section: Bring the ingredients you prepared back to Chongyun

dialogue.t: Is it finished? Oh... the color seems to be off...
Let me try one.
O—Okay... here it goes.
*licks popsicle* U—Ugh...
It's so spicy! ...My throat is on fire!
...No, no — this is not good!

quests.description: Dalong leaves after having been given all the popsicles, feeling most pleased. For Chongyun, these popsicles are essential to suppressing his pure-yang spirit, and so he must have some on his person at any given time. The two of you head to Wanmin Restaurant to restock.

quests.title: For A Child's Smile

dialogue.section: Give the newly-made popsicles to Dalong

dialogue.t: Where did you get these? I didn't give you any Mora.
You didn't steal them, did you!?
No, I didn't steal 'em! I talked to a nice person and they just gave 'em to me.
So, you've been asking for food on the street! I've already told you, such behavior makes you look uneducated!
How could you ask a stranger for food? Is that any different from being a beggar?
B—But, but I didn't ask them for it... They asked me if I wanted some!
That's it, no more lies! Just be honest about your mistake!
Uh, excuse me. He got those popsicles from me. He never asked us, we just gave them to him.
Yeah, this is the nice person I was telling you about!
Wh—Who are you?

My name is Chongyun. As you could probably tell from my attire, I'm an exorcist. Your son really seemed interested in popsicles, so we thought we'd make a batch for you. That's why we're paying you a visit.

dialogue.sit: There's no need to worry.
We're not bad guys.

dialogue.t: O—Oh, I see. Sorry, I seem to have misunderstood him.
I'm sorry, Dalong. It was wrong for Mommy to blame you.
It's okay, Mommy. So am I allowed to talk to the nice popsicle man now?
Sure, but please keep an eye on your sister. Mommy will be back after some errands, okay?
Don't worry, I'll look after her. Bye, Mommy!
Thanks, if it wasn't for you, I would have been in big trouble again.
Thank you for the popsicle. It was so cool and delicious.

dialogue.sit: Actually, we've made some more.
I bet you're still hungry.

dialogue.t: Oh, wow, look at all the popsicles! Thanks!

dialogue.sit: Don't eat them all in one go, you'll get brain freeze!
Eating too many will upset your stomach.

dialogue.t: Okay, I've got it. Thanks, you guys! Y—You're like heroes!
Heroes?
Yeah, I've been telling a story to my sister recently, and she admires the story's heroes very much. They're chivalrous, just, and they help the weak fight against evil.
And the heroes always have a good partner. One hero can beat up two bad guys, but with a good partner, they can defeat even more!
You two must be very good partners.
Uh, w—well...

dialogue.sit: That's right, we're great partners.

dialogue.t: Yay, I knew it! You two must get along well together.

dialogue.sit: Actually, we just met...

dialogue.t: Really? It sure doesn't seem that way. I bet you two will have a bright future together!
Um... we're gonna go play right now... Oh! Would you come and play with us?
Don't be so childish! I'm sure heroes like them have important things to do.
Huh? You mean you can't play?

dialogue.sit: It wouldn't hurt to go play a little, right?

dialogue.t: Huh? W—Well, I...
Sorry, could I have a word with you, Traveler?
They look so excited to play with us, but I'm sure they'll be disappointed if we refuse.

dialogue.sit: I have time.
Let's go play with them for a while.

dialogue.t: ...Sure, that's fine, but...

dialogue.sit: Something on your mind?

dialogue.t: No, it's nothing, I'm just... a little bit worried.
I spend most of my time purging evil spirits and practicing thaumaturgy.
And besides my training, I also need to constantly focus deeply on my own emotions to avoid losing control.
So, what I mean is that I seldom have time for anything that others would consider "fun." I don't even know the first thing about playing with kids...
They think we're heroes, so they must be very excited to play with us. But, I'm afraid that they'll just find me... boring.

dialogue.sit: It's simple, just be confident.

dialogue.t: ...R—Really? I just don't want to disappoint them...

dialogue.sit: Just treat it as if you're getting together with friends.

dialogue.t: I see... But my friends aren't the type who'd go out and play...

dialogue.sit: Don't worry. I've got you covered.

dialogue.t: Great! That's reassuring.
Alright, let's give it a try.
But I'll need your help if I don't know what to do.
Yay, they're back! So can we go play now?
Uh, yeah... I'll try.
Hahaha, yay! No need to be nervous... we're gonna have a blast!
Um... Oh, I know! Um — let's play hide-and-seek! Um — you'll be the ghost... But — um — don't peek until you count to fifty!
Wh—Who? Me?

dialogue.sit: He might not be familiar with the rules.

dialogue.t: Huh? I don't know anyone who doesn't know how to play hide-and-seek. Uh... okay, you can be the ghost then!

dialogue.sit: Let me play the ghost first.

dialogue.t: Okay. We'll go hide now. You'll have to find all three of us if you wanna win!
Hehe, you'll never be able to find me!
You mean, we just hide anywhere we want?
Of course, silly! That's the most fun part of the game!
But don't follow me! There's only room for one person in my secret hiding spot!
Uhh, alright... but I still don't really know what to do.

dialogue.sit: Don't be so serious.
Just use your imagination.
Who knows, maybe you'll be good at this.

dialogue.t: You're right. I'll give it a try.
Yay! Let's go hide! No peeking now...
Hm... Mommy's still not back yet. I'm starving...
Do you two know how to cook at all?
Don't be so selfish. They've played with us for a long time already.
...If we played for so long, then a little longer won't hurt...
No, it's alright. But I'm not too picky about the taste of food, as long as it doesn't make me feel unwell.
Unwell? A—Are you sick? Mommy says you should always take care of yourself!
No, it's not so serious. I just need to be careful about what I eat.
For example, Noodles with Mountain Delicacies. The dish tastes great, but I can't eat anything warm. So I came up with my own variation called "Cold Noodles with Mountain Delicacies."
C—Cold noodles! That sounds nice and cool. I wanna try!
Well, I don't think they taste quite as good as when they're served warm.
No way, I'm sure it's just as good as the popsicles! Or even better!
Uh, well...

dialogue.sit: It's your time to shine! I'll help prepare the ingredients.
I happen to have some ingredients here.
I want to try some, too!

dialogue.t: Y—You want to try too? Okay, I guess I'll have to make it.
Hmm, alright. We can use the kitchen here. I'll prepare the noodles once all the ingredients are ready.

dialogue.section: Give the ingredients to Chongyun

dialogue.t: So? How does it taste?

dialogue.sit: It's delicious.

dialogue.t: *sigh* That's a relief. I'm glad you like it.

dialogue.sit: It's unique. The texture is different compared to warm noodles.

dialogue.t: Unique? I guess I'll take that as a compliment...

dialogue.sit: You should open a restaurant!

dialogue.t: Ah, y—you flatter me! No need to exaggerate, though.
Let's serve the dish to the kids.
I hope they'll like it.
Wow, it tastes amazing! I've never had anything like this before.
You're not only a hero b—but also a chef! What a surprise!
Is there more? I want seconds!
Me too! Me too!
Whoa, slow down there! There's plenty more.
Ugh, I'm so full... You're so amazing!
Now that we're done, let's play more games!
M—More games?

dialogue.sit: Seems you're becoming quite popular.
Seems you're quite likable after all.

dialogue.t: This is completely unexpected for me. I was sure that everyone would just think I'm boring...
No, way! You're so much fun. And if you weren't so icy all the time, you'd be even more fun!
C'mon let's go, I wanna play something else!

dialogue.section: Give the ingredients to Chongyun

dialogue.t: Ah, you found me!
I can't believe I lost! I didn't expect you to be so good at this.

dialogue.section: Talk to Dalong and Little Le

dialogue.t: I never expected you to find me so easily...

dialogue.sit: It's only your first time.
...Why would you hide here?

dialogue.t: I thought that this would be the perfect spot.
In fact, I'm well-versed in the methods of locating evil spirits, and I have lots of experience tracking down their hiding spots.
This spot is dusty and a bit gloomy, which gives off an unsettling energy. Evil spirits usually prefer such places.

dialogue.sit: You're trying to use thaumaturgy to play hide-and-seek...

dialogue.t: Yeah... I guess my experience as an exorcist doesn't apply very well.

dialogue.sit: But you can be easily seen here.

dialogue.t: Hmm... I guess I was so nervous that I neglected the most important thing.
Since I've been found, I guess I must admit my defeat.
It's a simple game, yet quite intriguing once you begin to play.

dialogue.sit: Maybe we could play it together again sometime.

dialogue.t: Sure, we could invite more friends to join us.

dialogue.sit: Good thing you weren't the ghost.

dialogue.t: Hehe, right. It might've taken me hours to find anyone.
Let's go.

dialogue.section: Talk to Dalong and Little Le

dialogue.t: Huh, you found me!? How did you know to look for me here...
Heyyyy — you didn't peek, did you?
Are all the ingredients ready?
Aw, the popsicle man is a ghost now, too!
How did you know to look for me here...
You didn't peek, did you?
...Did the popsicle man tell you where to find me?
Cold noodles! Cold noodles!
I've never tasted cold noodles, I can't wait to try some...

quests.description: Chongyun's mind is still on that kid named Dalong even after you've made some more popsicles. The two of you head to Chihu Rock, intending to give the new popsicles to him as well.

quests.title: Test of Courage

dialogue.section: Go to Wuwang Hill and take part in the Test of Courage

dialogue.t: Please be careful, everyone. Pay close attention to your surroundings and stay vigilant once you enter.
And most importantly, don't get separated from your partner and wander off on your own. You'll most certainly be in for a scare if you go alone.
Did you hear that? He's warning the event participants. Maybe something strange really did happen here...
Let's investigate.

dialogue.sit: (I think you misunderstood that...)

dialogue.t: Hehe, welcome to the Test of Courage! You two must be very close friends.
Actually, we just met...
Hah, no problem at all. Don't be shy, just enjoy yourselves!
But please drink this before you enter the Test of Courage.
This drink will boost the yang energy inside your body and lift your courage.
Not only that, but this drink will also allow you to see things which are usually hidden from the naked eye... Pretty exciting, huh?
Y—Yang energy?
That's right. Ghosts are said to be full of "yin energy," so more "yang energy" will surely deter them.
Whoa, I've never heard of such a drink. Is it a secret recipe, or maybe some kind of potion?

dialogue.sit: Perhaps it's all just psychological.

dialogue.t: Hmm, possibly... But why bother exaggerating it so much then?

dialogue.sit: I think you might've misunderstood this whole "Test of Courage" thing.

dialogue.t: Surely not, he keeps emphasizing that there are frightening things inside. I'm almost certain it's some powerful evil spirit.
But if this drink really does boost yang energy, then it's potentially dangerous for me.

dialogue.sit: Dangerous?

dialogue.t: *sigh* You see, I have a very rare constitution called a "pure-yang spirit."
Such a constitution allows me to scare away evil spirits, but also makes me prone to emotional impulses.

dialogue.sit: You seem like a very calm person to me.

dialogue.t: I am constantly focusing to keep my mind and body in a normal state, which usually works until I suffer from some external stress...
Come now, what's with that serious expression on your face, lad? You aren't worried about the drink, are you?
It's delicious and quite effective if I do say so myself! There's nothing to worry about.
Or if you're still unsure, perhaps only one of you could take the drink. The person who takes the drink can protect the one who doesn't. It'll be exciting either way!
Hmm, it's hard to refuse when you put it that way...

dialogue.sit: Let's both drink it. If you lose control, I'll be sure to take care of you.
Just let me drink it alone.

dialogue.t: Alright, here it is! Please drink it slowly.
Haha! Yes, that's it, you did great! You two may enter now.
Alright, here it is! Please drink it slowly.
Haha! Yes, that's it, you did great! You two may enter now.

dialogue.section: Go to Wuwang Hill and take part in the Test of Courage

dialogue.t: You two may enter now. Have fun!
I hope this will strengthen your friendship, hehehe...

dialogue.section: Go to the site of the Test of Courage

dialogue.t: So, this is the Test of Courage! Hmm, there are more people here than I imagined.
They could all be in grave danger if there really is an evil spirit here. We must get to the bottom of this!
I'm not too sure where we should start, but I know we'll find something once we start looking.
These innocent participants are completely oblivious to the potential danger here. We'll need to protect them.

dialogue.sit: The Test of Courage isn't actually dangerous, you know.

dialogue.t: Wh—What? Please, enlighten me.

dialogue.sit: The participants are just here to have fun.

dialogue.t: You mean, being scared is like "entertainment" to them?

dialogue.sit: You're taking this event too seriously.

dialogue.t: I see... *sigh* Maybe you're right. I'm certainly a stranger to entertainment, after all.
I mostly spend my time purging evil spirits and practicing thaumaturgy.
Besides training, I also need to constantly focus on my own emotions to avoid losing control.
So I rarely have any time for leisure activities. I'm completely unfamiliar with what others would consider entertainment.

dialogue.sit: I see...

dialogue.t: Hm... Well, either way, let's check the area for any evil spirits, just in case. Where should we start?

dialogue.section: Go to the site of the Test of Courage

dialogue.t: If not "babe," then... how about "darling"?
Hmph, don't you try to sweet talk me!

dialogue.section: Look around for any sign of evil spirits

dialogue.t: This is all your fault! This place nearly scared me to death!
Alright, alright, don't lose your temper. We're leaving now, okay?
Hmm... To think I used to believe you were brave.
B—But this is different!
Excuse me, but I couldn't help but overhear your conversation. Did you perchance encounter an evil spirit?
If so, I'm here to track it. Could you please tell me which direction it went?
Wh—Who are you?
No, I didn't see anything, so don't ask!
So please just leave me alone. I don't know what you're talking about, and I certainly don't want anything to do with an evil spirit.
My apologies, perhaps you misunderstood what I meant. I only wish to know what the spirit looks like and which way it went so we could track it down.
If you can't describe its appearance, then at least show us the way it went.
Sh—Show you the way? No, I'm not going anywhere!
N—No, we're not taking you anywhere. I am just asking you to show us—
Ugh, no, forget it!
Alright, that's enough. Listen, if you keep talking like that, she might actually end up believing in that nonsense.
Can't you see she's terrified enough already? You can go find whatever strange things you're looking for on your own.
My apologies, I didn't mean to frighten her.

dialogue.sit: He's quite the serious exorcist.

dialogue.t: Yes, I'm just trying to hunt the evil spirit you mentioned to prevent it from hurting anyone.
Isn't it a bit strange for an exorcist to come to the Test of Courage looking for evil spirits?
Oh... I think I get it now. But we didn't say anything about a ghost or spirit. I think you misunderstood us.
I brought my girlfriend here to have some fun, but instead, she got frightened by all this spooky atmosphere. Now we'll just have to go home.
*sigh* I'm not too sure what you're looking for, but we did see some dark shadows making strange noises.
Thank you very much. That's very helpful.
Well, you heard it. It seems something unusual is going on here.
But why would they ever want to come here if they get scared so easily?

dialogue.sit: The point isn't getting scared, it's relying on each other in the face of fear.

dialogue.t: Interesting... I have never had any fear of evil spirits, so perhaps I'm unable to understand their feelings.
It's amazing that you're able to pick up on that. Good thing I brought you as my partner!
Anyway, let's keep searching the area.

dialogue.section: Look around for any sign of evil spirits

dialogue.t: Please... just call my name if you run into any in danger.

dialogue.section: Look around for any sign of evil spirits

dialogue.t: Hmm, these are traces left by an evil spirit, no doubt about it!
The traces are quite weak, though, so there are only two possibilities. Either the spirit that left the traces is very weak, or it has already left for some time now.
Either way, these possibilities prove my hunch that there's indeed an evil spirit here.

dialogue.sit: Are evil spirits the reason why Wuwang Hill is so gloomy all the time?

dialogue.t: No, I don't think so. There have been many rumors regarding the cause of Wuwang Hill's gloomy aura, but nothing is certain.
Although, once it became the murky place you see now, it also began to attract more evil spirits.
Anyway, these traces lead us one step closer to finding an evil spirit.

dialogue.section: Look around for any sign of evil spirits

dialogue.t: Don't come over here again!
Seriously, just leave me alone!
Why must you be so obstinate?
Just calm down! It's not what you think.
No, don't even bother! You think I don't know what you're doing?
Stop! Not a step closer!
Don't be afraid! I'll exorcise it right now!
Exorcise it?
Wh—Who are you? And what are you talking about?
Wait? What?

dialogue.sit: Everyone, just calm down.

dialogue.t: Oh, he's just a person? Ah, it seems I've made a mistake.
After seeing her resist so violently, I thought for sure an evil spirit was trying to harm her.
Nah, it's not like that at all! She's just... throwing a tantrum.
Excuse me? A "tantrum"? This is supposed to be a date, you know?
And now that we're finally here, you don't wanna go anywhere, and you just wanna hang around the entrance. What's the point in that?
Alright, fine! I was just about to walk in with you...
Look, I—I'm sorry. I'm just a little bit scared, that's all. That's why I've been stalling. I was wrong, okay?
Now that someone else is here, let's take a moment to calm down.

dialogue.sit: They seem to be here to participate just like everyone else.
I think we're intruding on them.

dialogue.t: *sigh* I wasn't thinking clearly. It was pure impulse...
I'm sorry, p—please forgive me. Will you give me another chance?
...Fine... I know that I shouldn't have yelled at you.
Oh... It doesn't matter anymore. You're still the best, babe.
Uh, who said you could call me "babe"? Ugh, you're so annoying!
Huh, so they really are on a date? But why in such a dangerous place like this?
...Perhaps we should just leave them alone.

quests.description: The young thaumaturge Chongyun has obtained a great amount of (rather unreliable-sounding) information concerning evil spirits, but you decide not to expose this fact out of courtesy. The way Chongyun sees it, the most likely spot for evil spirits to show up is Wuwang Hill, where a Test of Courage is currently taking place. The test requires two people to go in together, so you accept his invitation and accompany him there...

quests.title: Sudden Discomfort

dialogue.t: ...Sorry... Sorry, I feel... unwell.
...I think the drink we had earlier stirred the yang energy inside my body.

dialogue.sit: Is it that serious?

dialogue.t: If there's too much yang energy, I'm afraid that I won't be able to control myself. Even though you were willing to accompany me this far, I don't want to cause you any further trouble.

dialogue.sit: But we've finally found some traces of an evil spirit.

dialogue.t: If I lose control, I fear that I'll be the one endangering everyone here, not evil spirits. ...We'd better find somewhere to rest.

dialogue.sit: Sure, just have a rest. I'll continue investigating on my own.
Let me help you find a place to rest.

dialogue.t: Alright. You are an experienced adventurer, after all. I won't be far, so just call for help if you run into any danger.
Ughhh...

dialogue.sit: Is there anything I can do to help?

dialogue.t: The feeling... it's becoming more intense...
Usually, I can manage by simply eating a popsicle... but that's only under normal circumstances...
I may need something... a bit more potent in this case...
Like Cryo Slime Condensate, or Cryo Whopperflower Nectar, for example...

dialogue.sit: I think I have some.

dialogue.t: You've collected these during your adventures, right? But I'm afraid they're no good... They're not fresh enough.
Perhaps they're fine as typical ingredients, but they won't be potent enough to suppress the abundance of yang energy inside me.
Ugh... sorry to trouble you again...
Thank you... I'll be resting here.
...I should be able to manage for the time being if I... just focus on keeping calm.
Thank you... I'll be resting here.
...I should be able to manage for the time being if I... just focus on keeping calm.
*sigh* Well, at least we've found some useful clues. We'll need to keep searching further in.
But to avoid alerting the evil spirit, perhaps I should wait here.

dialogue.sit: You're not coming?

dialogue.t: When we were collecting clues just now, we were still unsure whether any evil spirit is actually here or not. But now that possibility seems higher, it would be wise to proceed more cautiously.
Our efforts will be wasted if my yang energy scares the evil spirit away.
Besides, I trust your capability and experience as an adventurer.
If you come across a powerful demon, I'll get there as fast as possible.

dialogue.sit: Just wait for my word.

dialogue.t: Alright, thank you.
Sorry for troubling you again...
Just be careful while collecting the ingredients...

dialogue.section: Look for Cryo Whopperflower Nectar

dialogue.t: It's dangerous to walk alone here, isn't it?
You have no idea who... or what you'll meet.

dialogue.sit: Hello.

dialogue.t: Hmm, you seem to be pretty calm. You know, there's a saying, "you can't keep your shoes dry if you keep walking along the river."
You're bound to run into something in such a strange and eerie place...
And what you encounter here could become a nightmare that haunts you for the rest of your life.

dialogue.sit: Oh, really?
Sorry, I don't get it... What are you doing here?

dialogue.t: Huh? How are you so calm? People usually run away in terror before I can even finish a sentence.

dialogue.sit: You look like just another average person to me.

dialogue.t: Yeah... but a more sophisticated way to play a ghost is to create a creepy atmosphere that scares people psychologically.
In which case, my appearance becomes irrelevant.

dialogue.sit: Don't you have a costume or anything like that?

dialogue.t: Yes, I have one, but it's too hot to wear... and besides, a more sophisticated way to play a ghost is to create a creepy atmosphere that scares people psychologically.
In which case, my appearance becomes irrelevant.
*sigh* Besides, I'll never be able to scare someone like you who doesn't believe in ghosts to begin with.

dialogue.sit: Sounds like you're just slacking off to me...

dialogue.t: Hey, that's not true! Oh, I'd better go find some wimps to scare now!
You should go back and find your partner. He might be terrified by now.

dialogue.section: Look for Cryo Whopperflower Nectar

dialogue.t: It's dangerous to walk alone here, isn't it?
You have no idea who... or what you'll meet.

dialogue.sit: Hello.

dialogue.t: Hmm, you seem to be pretty calm. You know, there's a saying, "you can't keep your shoes dry if you keep walking along the river."
You're bound to run into something in such a strange and eerie place...
And what you encounter here could become a nightmare that haunts you for the rest of your life.

dialogue.sit: Oh, really?
Sorry, I don't get it... What are you doing here?

dialogue.t: Huh? How are you so calm? People usually run away in terror before I can even finish a sentence.

dialogue.sit: You look like just another average person to me.

dialogue.t: Yeah... but a more sophisticated way to play a ghost is to create a creepy atmosphere that scares people psychologically.
In which case, my appearance becomes irrelevant.

dialogue.sit: Don't you have a costume or anything like that?

dialogue.t: Yes, I have one, but it's too hot to wear... and besides, a more sophisticated way to play a ghost is to create a creepy atmosphere that scares people psychologically.
In which case, my appearance becomes irrelevant.
*sigh* Besides, I'll never be able to scare someone like you who doesn't believe in ghosts to begin with.

dialogue.sit: Sounds like you're just slacking off to me...

dialogue.t: Hey, that's not true! Oh, I'd better go find some wimps to scare now!
You should go back and find your partner. He might be terrified by now.
Ugh... I'm beat. Finally, I can take a break.
*sigh* I wonder if I took things a little too far... A few people seemed scared out of their minds.

dialogue.sit: Who are you?

dialogue.t: Huh? Hey, you shouldn't be here!
*sigh* Never mind. I assume you overheard me anyway.
I work here pretending to be a ghost, but now's my break time, so I took off my costume. I get all hot and stuffy wearing that thing...

dialogue.sit: So there are no real ghosts here?
It's all planned to scare people, right?

dialogue.t: Of course, how could there be real ghosts here?
No one wants to see a real ghost, neither us nor the participants.
They just come here for the atmosphere, or should I say, the chance... Everyone wants the chance to feel the thrill of excitement.
When people find themselves in a scary situation, they'll say things that they'd never dare to otherwise. That's what the Test of Courage is all about.

dialogue.sit: I think I understand.
(Chongyun will be very disappointed.)

dialogue.t: *sigh* Okay... I should get back to work now. Hope you and... whoever you're here with have a fun time.
You're back! So how did it go? Did you see an evil spirit...?

dialogue.sit: No, I only saw an event staff member pretending to be a ghost.

dialogue.t: Huh...? So that's what's going on here!?
No evil spirits...? No danger...? It's all just a setup...?

dialogue.sit: I'm sorry, but that seems to be the truth.
That's all there is to the Test of Courage.
It's just for entertainment, you took it way too seriously.

dialogue.t: I—I see... it seems I've been tricked again.
Uh oh, I'm starting to feel more and more... uncomfortable.
Now that everything's settled here... let's head back to Liyue Harbor.
But could you... help me walk back?

dialogue.sit: You don't look so good.

dialogue.t: It's fine... I'll be okay...
No, really... I'm fine...

quests.description: You and Chongyun successfully enter the Test of Courage, but as you track the evil spirits, Chongyun suddenly experiences a rush of unstable yang energy and must rest. To prevent his constitution from going out of control, you look for something that might help suppress his pure-yang spirit...

quests.title: Independent Actions

dialogue.t: Ugh... I'm beat. Finally, I can take a break.
*sigh* I wonder if I took things a little too far... A few people seemed scared out of their minds.

dialogue.sit: Who are you?

dialogue.t: Huh? Hey, you shouldn't be here!
*sigh* Never mind. I assume you overheard me anyway.
I work here pretending to be a ghost, but now's my break time, so I took off my costume. I get all hot and stuffy wearing that thing...

dialogue.sit: So there are no real ghosts here?
It's all planned to scare people, right?

dialogue.t: Of course, how could there be real ghosts here?
No one wants to see a real ghost, neither us nor the participants.
They just come here for the atmosphere, or should I say, the chance... Everyone wants the chance to feel the thrill of excitement.
When people find themselves in a scary situation, they'll say things that they'd never dare to otherwise. That's what the Test of Courage is all about.

dialogue.sit: I think I understand.
(Chongyun will be very disappointed.)

dialogue.t: *sigh* Okay... I should get back to work now. Hope you and... whoever you're here with have a fun time.
*sobbing* Huh...? Um...
Um... Can... C—Can you help me...?

dialogue.sit: Help you?
Why me?

dialogue.t: Um, that exorcist... with that blue hair... is so scary!
C—Can you lead him away from here? He makes me feel so frightened...

dialogue.sit: Are you being affected by his yang energy?
No wonder we haven't seen you all day.

dialogue.t: I wouldn't dare get anywhere near him... His energy... It's so horrible! It'll make me disappear!
...I don't want to disappear! Please, help me...

dialogue.sit: I wonder if he'd consider you an evil spirit...
He'll have to be the one that decides what to do.

dialogue.t: ...Well... I—I have an idea.
Um... I—I saw the exorcist with blue hair a—arguing with someone over there a few minutes ago.
I'll scare those troublemakers away, but y—you have to ask the exorcist to let me go, okay?

dialogue.sit: Are you telling the truth?

dialogue.t: O—Of course... Qianqian never lies.

dialogue.sit: I can get him out of trouble myself.

dialogue.t: ...Yeah but... it'll be complicated. I've already got a plan, you must believe me!
So, um... What do you say?

dialogue.sit: He'll be the one that decides, but I'll try to explain the situation as best I can.

dialogue.t: Um... Uh, okay... So, I'll take that as a "yes"?
I hope the exorcist with blue hair is a good person.
Um... So, I'll help him, and you'll go talk to him. Hopefully, then he'll leave me alone... Sound good?
You're back! How did it go? Did you see an evil spirit...?

dialogue.sit: No, I only saw an event staff member pretending to be a ghost.

dialogue.t: Huh...? So that's what's going on here!?
No evil spirits...? No danger...? It's all just a setup...?

dialogue.sit: I'm sorry, but that seems to be the truth.
That's all there is to the Test of Courage.
It's just for entertainment, you took it way too seriously.

dialogue.t: I—I see... So I was wrong again.
*sigh* In that case, I suppose there's no reason for us to linger here any longer.

dialogue.sit: Right, let's head back.

dialogue.t: Thanks for finding these ingredients for me. I feel much better now.
Although I still feel the yang energy stirring, at least I won't need to worry about it getting out of control.
So, did you find any new leads when you were out looking for ingredients?

dialogue.sit: No, I only saw an event staff member pretending to be a ghost.

dialogue.t: Huh...? So that's what's going on here!?
Does that mean that all the strange things here are just a hoax?

dialogue.sit: I'm sorry, but that seems to be the truth.
That's all there is to the Test of Courage.

dialogue.t: It's just for entertainment, you took it way too seriously.
I—I see... so I was wrong again.
...In that case, I suppose there's no reason for us to linger here any longer.

dialogue.sit: Right, let's head back.

dialogue.t: Yes, that was proof of an evil spirit's presence, but we can't be sure if the spirit's still here.
Actually, I would also like to investigate that further...

dialogue.sit: We've already come all this way, let's have a look.

dialogue.t: You're right. I'll focus my mind and spirit.
Perhaps it'd be more effective for us to split up.
Evil spirits will keep their distance if they sense the power of my pure-yang spirit.
So you'll be more likely to find one if you're on your own.

dialogue.sit: And then I'll wait for you to come and defeat it?

dialogue.t: Yes, that would be best. Just keep it distracted till I arrive.

dialogue.sit: I might defeat the spirit by the time you arrive.

dialogue.t: Another means to the same end. Don't worry about me, purging it is the priority.
I'll take this side, you take the other side. Let's move.
I'm sorry, this has all been a waste of your precious time...

dialogue.sit: Don't take it to heart.
Maybe we could hang out together sometime.

dialogue.t: Hehe, you are very kind.
At least we checked the Test of Courage together and verified that the place is clear of danger...
*sigh* But if only we had found some evil spirits, then it all would have been worthwhile...

dialogue.section: Talk to Chongyun about Qianqian

dialogue.t: Hey, you've been turning the whole place upside down looking for "evil spirits." Other participants are starting to complain!
Yeah! Why would an exorcist show up at the Test of Courage and tell everyone that there are no ghosts here? You're just stirring up trouble!

Honestly, I find this whole thing quite confusing. If there really are ghosts here, then you're using them to make Mora regardless of the participants' safety. You tell me, is that ethical business practice?
And if there are no ghosts here, then your so-called Test of Courage is nothing but a big scam!
Not only are you avoiding my questions, but now you accuse me of causing trouble?
I've already told you! This is what kind of event the Test of Courage is! It's not our problem that you're taking it so seriously.
And now that you're disturbing our participants, we'll have to ask you to leave.
If anything about this made any sense at all, I would leave of my own volition.
But if I leave now, I'm leaving evil spirits to their own devices.

dialogue.sit: (I wonder what I should say in this situation...)

dialogue.t: Help!!!
G—Ghost! There's a ghost!
Run for your life!
Wh—What's going on!?
Everyone's starting to panic! I—Is there really a ghost?
Don't be silly! But if everyone starts running, someone could get hurt!
Everyone! Just calm down — no need to panic. Please move in an orderly fashion!
I see... So there's no evil spirits here, just a wandering ghost.
And she scared everyone away because I was in trouble?

dialogue.sit: She only scared them. She didn't hurt anyone.

dialogue.t: If things are as you say, then she doesn't seem like a malignant spirit.

dialogue.sit: She's a ghost, but she's also just a kid.
I'll let you be the judge.

dialogue.t: Alright... As long as she promises not to harm anyone, then I'll pretend that I never knew about her.
However, if she ever does harm anyone, it'll be my job as an exorcist to come and purge her... To mend my mistake.

dialogue.sit: I don't think that day will ever come.

dialogue.t: I hope so...

dialogue.sit: I'll be equally responsible, too.

dialogue.t: No... No, no, this is my call. I shall take full responsibility.
...We should go now. It doesn't seem we're particularly welcome here anyway.
...What's wrong?

dialogue.sit: I was under the impression that you wouldn't be willing to let Qianqian go.

dialogue.t: I have faith in my judgment of good and evil.
But, if I begin to neglect my perception of good and evil, it may lead to something I'd regret for the rest of my days.

dialogue.sit: This sounds just like something you would say.
I didn't expect you to have a gentle side.

dialogue.t: Wait, you mean... you didn't think I could be fair and reasonable?
R—Really? Do I look so obstinate?

dialogue.sit: It doesn't matter.
I know you better now.

dialogue.t: Yeah, you're right. Alright, we should leave now.

dialogue.sit: Wait a moment.
Let's say goodbye to Qianqian.

dialogue.t: Ahh... Hmm... Okay.

quests.description: Chongyun's pure-yang spirit has finally been brought under control, but he is now aware that the strange goings-on during the Test of Courage are a result of human activity. However, neither of you is ready to give up yet, and at Chongyun's suggestion, you split up and continue to search for traces of the paranormal...
